result.topic_en: The page gives literature references on orthogonal substitution coefficients and on functions with periodic continued fraction expansions, a remark on Cantor's table of representations of even numbers as sums of two primes with an averaging estimate, and the idea of mappings between n-dimensional regions governed by linear PDEs as a generalisation of conformal mapping.
